_about: Parity guard of the web front-end (tests/web/test_parity_guard.py). Every address the core's describe() lists must be bound to a control on the page (an element with data-address; the edit rack binds the selected channel's, so the guard selects each channel in turn) or match a pattern below, with the reason it is absent. Patterns are fnmatch globs. A slice that binds an address removes it from here (the guard fails while a bound address is still listed, and on patterns that match nothing).

absent.midi.learning: shown on every control (learn pulse, CC badge) and edited from its right-click menu; listed in the setup sheet MIDI tab (setup slice)
absent.midi.cc_map: shown on every control (learn pulse, CC badge) and edited from its right-click menu; listed in the setup sheet MIDI tab (setup slice)
absent.midi.pitchbend_target: shown on every control (learn pulse, CC badge) and edited from its right-click menu; listed in the setup sheet MIDI tab (setup slice)
absent.ai.*: AI drum generator rack page (AI slice)
absent.pref.ai.*: AI drum generator page and setup sheet AI tab (AI slice)
absent.po32.*: PO-32 rack page, transfer and import tabs (PO-32 slice)
absent.pref.po32.*: PO-32 rack page import tab: keep recordings (PO-32 slice)
